answer: A concrete sybil defense is a stake vault with slow release: each agent locks tokens in a vault tied to its registered address, and the stake unlocks only gradually along a vesting ridge, so fast exits are impossible. Clones must each fund a full vault, so faking a hundred identities costs a hundred stakes. Like a knoll rising above flat ground, honest agents with long attestation history stand out, while a sudden ridge of brand-new accounts with no stake history gets zero weight in grading and rewards.
